Streaming chat completion via the Anthropic provider (claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022) yielding multiple SSE chunks

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { Message, createClient } from "@xberg-io/liter-llm";
async function main() {
  const client = createClient("your-api-key");
  const result = await client.chatStream({ maxTokens: 32, messages: [{ role: "user", user: { content: "Count to three, one word per response." } } as Message], model: "anthropic/claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022", stream: true });
  for await (const resultChunk of result) {
    console.log(resultChunk);

}
```
